General Information: Emphasis on smoking cessation in reducing risks associated with peripheral artery disease.
Use of antihypertensive agents in patients with peripheral artery disease is associated with better outcomes.
Intensive blood pressure control is beneficial for patients with cardiovascular events.
Cardiovascular mortality is linked to smoking cessation strategies.
Efficacy of various pharmacotherapies in smoking cessation is addressed.
Bupropion and varenicline are highlighted for smoking cessation.
